title: ⚡ Bolt: headless rich fallbacks in termux-multi-agent dashboard
body:
⚡ Bolt Optimization:
Defined dummy/fallback UI classes (`Text`, `Panel`, `Group`, `Table`, `Live`, `ROUNDED`) in `termux-multi-agent/dashboard.py` when `rich` module is missing. This prevents runtime `NameError` exceptions when rendering dashboards or running telemetry unit tests in environments without `rich` installed.
